_why: NIGHT33 builder R (design.n33.kit33 swaps n32-span for this file): Tools/night/gen-n33-span.cjs = gen-n32-span.cjs. LEVEL 4, THE SPAN, rebuilt from scratch (NIGHT32, builder S, DESIGN32 card S; GG 2026-10-10: 'the 4th level ... completely overhauled again', 'the arenas are so boring'). A gantry yard over a lava gorge that turns back on itself: s1 TOLLGATE (the NAILGUN, a mezzanine, a lava trench with one bridge), s2 FIRST HOOK (one ring over lava to a terrace; the stairs are the slow way), s3 ROPE AND RIDE (two rings with the north wall's ride between, the travel turns east), s3b CRUCIBLE (new: a three-tier fight), s4 HOOK FIGHT (islands in a lava cross, rings over the channel, a moving fight), s5 REST, s6 CHAIN (pull, wall ride, pull to the spitters' deck; the south ledge is the walk), s7 ESCALATION (the pylon in its moat with a ring of four, two balconies), s8 THE LOOM (the boss deck, kept). Every ring route is at most two pulls before ground, a wall ride or a kill (DESIGN32 G: 2 charges, 4 s). Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH.
name: LEVEL 4 THE SPAN
